verdict.summary: Round 3 closes the prior major finding. Section 6.1 now explicitly keeps both raw and derived candidate domains in the protected ephemeral/private handling class, prohibits every observed or derived hostname from durable or public telemetry, and requires allowlist entries to be independently typed by a trusted operator from provider documentation. Section 8.6 retains the load-bearing valid, repeated credential-encoded registrable-domain probe and now requires the candidate/review surface itself to contain zero marker occurrences. The document is internally consistent on this boundary: validation is only a bounds check, candidate frequency is not treated as sanitization, and durable telemetry is limited to counts and host-side allowlist-rule identifiers. I found no remaining correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue in the diff.
